title: Polish President is completely submissive to the “golden-haired alpha male with a red tie”
text: EUvsDisinfo – przypadek dezinformacji: Polish President is completely submissive to the “golden-haired alpha male with a red tie”. SUMMARY In the end, something good resulted from a mostly embarrassing visit of President Duda to the Big Brother. Clearly, it is a statement that “there are absolutely no plans to move the American nuclear weapons to Poland”. Taking into consideration the submission of the Head of the Polish state towards the golden-haired alpha male with a red tie, if Trump wanted to send the nuclear weapons to Poland (which the Germans want to get rid of) – we could have appeared in a truly tragic situation.
